slides.headline: Overall reserves increased GBP 8m to GBP 606m
slides.plain_text:
Executive Summary
Overall reserves increased GBP 8m to GBP 606m
Total reserve: GBP 606m
Quarterly movement: +GBP 8m
Ultimate claims: GBP 3,672.6m
The principal increases were Casualty +GBP 4m and Property +GBP 4m.
No projection-method selections changed this quarter.
Casualty strengthening is now a material contributor to reserve movement; Property large loss activity is a secondary theme.

slides.title: Reserving Class Commentary
slides.headline: Principal class movements and drivers
slides.plain_text:
Reserving Class Commentary
Principal class movements and drivers
Casualty: strengthened GBP 4m. Recent accident years remain the principal focus; strengthening reflects sustained adverse emergence.
Property: strengthened GBP 4m. Large loss development from the September windstorm events is the main driver.
Motor: broadly flat in the quarter.
Marine: broadly flat in the quarter.

slides.title: Key Uncertainties and Areas of Focus
slides.headline: Qualitative areas of focus from the actuarial review
slides.plain_text:
Key Uncertainties and Areas of Focus
Qualitative areas of focus from the actuarial review
Casualty strengthening is now material; the principal uncertainty is whether recent accident years have been strengthened sufficiently.
September windstorm events have increased Property large and catastrophe reserves; a management loading is held pending settlement.
Claims inflation remains elevated for liability classes.

slides.title: Conclusion and Next Review
slides.headline: Overall reserve conclusion and forward focus
slides.plain_text:
Conclusion and Next Review
Overall reserve conclusion and forward focus
Casualty strengthening and Property large loss development are the principal themes. Both will be revisited at the year-end review.
This review has been prepared by the actuarial function for management and Board use. Selections reflect actuarial judgement applied to the data available at the valuation date; they will be reassessed at the next quarterly review.
Total reserve: GBP 606m
